text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We managed to achieve solid results in the 
Kobe Shimbun Hai, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This race has been my goal for the 
year, so I cannot afford to lose under any 
circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We must secure a solid victory and carry 
that momentum forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(The 'Kikuka Sho' is the final Classic 
race. Naturally, Ryan will be running 
too...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I was picturing the road to victory once 
again. I shall surely win next time as 
well!"
